correctness.rationale: Exact root-of-unity Fourier inversion and quadratic Gauss evaluation give conjugate cosine/sine modes. The leading frequency j=1 has strictly largest modulus. The explicit inequality cos(u)-cos(2u)>=6/p² and |sin|,|cos| grid bounds imply domination beyond N_p. Skew symmetry gives zeros at p|n for p≡3 mod4 and p=3 is exact. Counting residue classes yields densities. The finite verifier is supplementary.

value.rationale: The Legendre-weighted ordinary binomial transform is a natural character-sensitive sum; its eventual sign, zero set and exact positive/negative/zero densities for all odd primes are intrinsic qualitative invariants, not arbitrary fixed-prime slices. The theorem supplies an explicit effective cutoff and a sharp dichotomy by p mod4, going beyond recurrence identities or isolated terms.
